call.description: Have a real-time voice call with the active character here.

twitch.description: Connect your Twitch channel and configure how the character joins chat here.

discord.description: Connect a Discord bot so the character can join your servers here.

avatar.description: Configure the character's reactive avatar here.

conversations.title: Conversations

composer.attachImageDisabled: Turn on vision in Settings > AI Providers to attach images

chat.noConversationTitle: What do you want to talk about with {{name}} today?
chat.noConversationDescription: Pick a conversation from the list or create a new one to start chatting.

dictation.start: Dictate message (hold; slide up to lock)
dictation.slideToLock: Slide up to lock the recording
dictation.lockedHint: Listening… press Stop when you're done

memory.noProfileDescription: Create your first character in the Identity tab so it can start building its own memory.
memory.emptyDescription: Chat with the character a bit — it extracts memories automatically every few messages, or you can add one by hand.
memory.deleteConfirmDescription: This memory will be permanently deleted. This action cannot be undone.

fields.title: Title
fields.summaryHint: The short version the character actually recalls in every conversation — leave it blank to use the detail instead.
fields.contentHint: The fuller version, for looking back later — it doesn't need to be very long.

scope.publicTitle: Twitch and Discord can use it too. Private ones are only used by Chat and Call.
scope.confirmDescription: Twitch and Discord will be able to use this memory when replying, so anyone writing there could see it reflected in an answer. You can make it private again at any time.

activity.emptyDescription: You'll see a live log of what the app is doing here — generated replies, web searches, each channel's connections.
activity.clearConfirmDescription: The entire activity log will be deleted. This action cannot be undone.

identity.emptyDescription: Project Ciel characters are created by you — there is no default one. Give it a name to start; you can fill in the rest afterwards.
identity.subtitle: Character identity
identity.deleteConfirmDescription: Their identity and personality will be permanently removed. This can't be undone.
identity.previewEmpty: Type something in Info or Personality to see the generated prompt here.

fields.name: Name
fields.relationshipToUser: Who are you to the user?
fields.relationshipToUserHint: E.g.: companion, friend, assistant, VTuber, streaming buddy…
fields.userRole: Who is the user to you?
fields.userRoleHint: Write freely how your character sees the user.

personality.freeDescriptionPlaceholder: Describe in your own words how you want them to be…

appearance.themeDescription: Pick a full theme for the active character, or leave it themeless and just customize the accent.
appearance.customAccentDescription: Replaces the chosen theme's (or the default theme's) accent color with your own.
appearance.roundnessCustom: Applied to every theme, no matter which one you pick.

general.avatarDescription: Shown next to your own messages in Chat.
general.startWithSystemDescription: Open Project Ciel automatically when you log in.
general.minimizeToTrayHint: The X button no longer quits the app — it just hides it, still running in the system tray. To actually quit, right-click its icon and choose "Quit".
general.notifyProactiveHint: A desktop notification when the character writes to you on their own.
general.voiceWhileHidden: Play voice while in the tray
general.voiceWhileHiddenHint: Voice is muted by default while the app is minimized to the tray. Only matters if "Minimize to tray on close" is on.

aiProviders.title: AI Providers
aiProviders.description: Connect one or more providers. Turn on the ones you want to be able to pick manually, and pin the ones you want the system to switch to automatically if the one in use runs out of credits, hits its usage limit or stops responding — so the conversation never gets cut off.
aiProviders.empty: You haven't added any provider yet — pick one above to get started.
aiProviders.enableTitle: Available to pick manually at any time.
aiProviders.pinTitle: Besides being enabled, it's included in the automatic switch if the provider in use runs out of credits, hits its limit or stops responding.
aiProviders.name: Name
aiProviders.apiKeyStored: One is already saved — leave blank to keep it.
aiProviders.modelAutoCorrected: Detected a different model on the server — automatically selected "{{model}}".
aiProviders.visionAutoDetected: This model looks like it accepts images — Vision was turned on automatically.
aiProviders.visionHint: Only turn this on if the model loaded on the server actually accepts images — it isn't auto-detected.

keyHints.gemini: Get it at aistudio.google.com/apikey — the free plan has usage limits.
keyHints.groq: Get it at console.groq.com/keys — it has a free plan with usage limits.
keyHints.openrouter: Get it at openrouter.ai/keys — models whose name ends in ":free" cost nothing.
keyHints.cerebras: Get it at cloud.cerebras.ai — it has a free plan with usage limits.
keyHints.mistral: Get it at console.mistral.ai/api-keys — the "Experiment" plan is free with limits.
keyHints.deepseek: Create your key at platform.deepseek.com/api_keys — it's paid (prepaid balance).
keyHints.xai: Get it at console.x.ai — it's pay-as-you-go.
keyHints.sambanova: Get it at cloud.sambanova.ai/apis — it offers a free plan with limits (check its current terms).

aiProviders.preferredTitle: The app goes back to this provider on its own once it responds again.
aiProviders.localTitle: Runs on your own network: what you send it does not leave for the internet.
aiProviders.cloudTitle: An internet service: what you send it leaves your computer.

privacy.title: Privacy for this provider
privacy.localNote: Runs on your network: this only matters if you point it at a remote server.
privacy.cloudNote: A cloud service: choose which of your data it can receive.
privacy.visionOff: Off: minimal mode does not send images.

full.label: Full
full.hint: Receives the conversation and everything the character remembers about you (private and public memories), its mood, and any images you attach.

public_only.label: Public memories only
public_only.hint: Receives the conversation, mood and images, but of your memories only those marked public. It cannot merge memories.

minimal.label: Minimal
minimal.hint: Receives only the conversation: no memories, no mood, no images. It cannot merge memories. What you type in the chat does reach it: it could not answer otherwise.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: How much each provider has been used. These numbers stay on this computer; the text of your messages is never stored.
usage.empty: No usage in this period yet.
usage.estimateNote: Tokens are an estimate from the text, not what the provider bills.
usage.resetConfirmDescription: This clears the usage numbers of every provider. It does not affect your conversations or settings.

tts.title: Voice engine
tts.description: Connect one or more voice providers. Enable the ones you want available and use "Use now" to choose which one speaks right now — the system's native voice is always ready, no setup needed.
tts.enableTitle: Available to pick manually at any time.
tts.name: Name
tts.regionHint: Azure region where you created the Speech resource — for example "eastus".
tts.apiKeyStored: One is already saved — leave blank to keep it.
tts.testPhrase: This is a voice connection test.
tts.testPlayedHint: You should have heard a short test clip through your speakers.

keyHints.openai: Create your key at platform.openai.com/api-keys — it's paid.
keyHints.google: Enable the Cloud Text-to-Speech API in your Google Cloud project and create a key at console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials.
keyHints.azure: Create a Speech resource at portal.azure.com and use its key together with its region.
keyHints.fishaudio: Get it at fish.audio (API section). In the Voice tab paste the voice ID — it's in the URL of its page; leave it empty to use the default voice.
keyHints.deepgram: Get it at console.deepgram.com. In the Voice tab type the voice model, for example "aura-2-thalia-en"; leave it empty to use that one.
keyHints.groq: Get it at console.groq.com/keys. Groq's voice (Orpheus) speaks English (and Saudi Arabic) only and accepts 200 characters per request: long messages are split and joined automatically, but use several requests.
keyHints.together: Get it at api.together.ai/settings/api-keys. Its default voice (Orpheus) is meant for English; other models such as Kokoro have other voices.

modelHints.fishaudio: Empty uses "s2.1-pro-free": free for testing, no API credit needed (until 11/30/2026; Fish Audio may use requests to improve its model). For real use type "s2.1-pro".
modelHints.groq: Empty uses "canopylabs/orpheus-v1-english". For Saudi Arabic type "canopylabs/orpheus-arabic-saudi".
modelHints.together: Empty uses "canopylabs/orpheus-3b-0.1-ft". Other models in its catalogue: "hexgrad/Kokoro-82M", etc. — change the voice too.

webSearch.title: Web search for the character
webSearch.description: Lets the character search the web to answer questions that need a current fact — weather, the time somewhere else, news. Applies in Chat, Twitch, Discord, and Call.
webSearch.networkHint: With this on, those channels may need an Internet connection to answer some questions.
webSearch.apiKeyStored: One is already saved — leave blank to keep it.

stt.title: Speech transcription
stt.description: Transcribing your voice for AI Calls runs built into the app — no external server to install or configure. Download a model once and it works fully offline.

sizeHint.tiny: Fastest, limited accuracy — useful on modest hardware.
sizeHint.base: Good balance of speed and accuracy.
sizeHint.small: More accurate, a bit slower — recommended for most people.
sizeHint.medium: Most accurate, takes longer per reply.

stt.gpuToggleHint: Works on any GPU (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel) with no extra drivers. Falls back to CPU automatically if no compatible GPU is found.
stt.dictationAutoSendHint: When you stop the chat microphone, the transcribed text is sent right away. When off, it stays in the box so you can review it before sending.

memory.title: Semantic memory search
memory.description: Download a local model so memory search understands what you mean, not just the exact words. Runs built into the app, fully offline, once downloaded.
memory.backfillHint: Memories you already had before downloading the model won't be found by meaning until you backfill them once.
memory.fusionHint: The AI reviews the character's memories and proposes combining ones that are redundant or about the same thing — you decide which to apply before anything is deleted.
memory.fusionEmptyDescription: All current memories seem distinct enough from each other.

privacy.title: Known people
privacy.description: The app learns real people's names (from your conversations and the connected Twitch and Discord chats) to recognize them better when speaking. AI characters you create are added here automatically. Everything stays local, never sent to any server.
privacy.twitchAutoLearn: Automatically learn names from Twitch chat
privacy.twitchAutoLearnHint: Everyone who writes in your connected chat gets registered by name — can be turned off anytime.
privacy.discordAutoLearn: Automatically learn names from Discord server
privacy.discordAutoLearnHint: Everyone who writes in your connected Discord server gets registered by name — can be turned off anytime.

chatAudio.title: Save message audio
chatAudio.hint: Saves the audio generated in Chat so it can be replayed later without generating it again. Only works with online voices (ElevenLabs, Fish Audio, Google, Azure, OpenAI, Groq…) — native system voices speak directly and never produce a file that can be saved. The audio of replies read aloud automatically when they finish is saved, and so is the audio of the first time you press listen on a message; after that, that same audio is always played.
chatAudio.loadError: Could not load the saved-audio settings
chatAudio.saveError: Could not save the saved-audio settings

privacy.emptyHint: People will show up here as they're mentioned in conversations or in Twitch or Discord chat.
privacy.name: Name

credits.tagline: Your AI companion to chat, talk and stream with, with your data always staying with you.
credits.madeWithClaude: Developed with the help of Claude, by Anthropic
credits.supportDescription: If you enjoy Project Ciel, you can support its development.
credits.supportAction: Buy me a coffee on Ko-fi
credits.koreanReview: Checked that the Korean translation is correct enough for real use.

backup.createDescription: Saves everything of yours in a single file, so you can recover it if you switch computers or something goes wrong.
backup.includes: Includes: characters, chats, memories, settings, attachments and avatars.
backup.excludesSecrets: Does not include your API keys or Twitch/Discord tokens: for safety they stay in this computer's secure store. You will need to enter them again if you restore on another computer.
backup.excludesDownloads: Downloaded models (voice, semantic memory) are not included either; they can be downloaded again.
backup.restoreDescription: Pick a backup file. Before anything changes it is checked for integrity, and your current data is kept aside.
backup.confirmDescription: Backup from {{date}} ({{files}} attachment and avatar files, {{size}}). Your current data will be replaced by the backup's; the current data is kept in the “pre-restore” folder inside the app data. The app will restart.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics center
diagnostics.description: The state of the app at a glance: what works, what doesn't and why.
diagnostics.noSecrets: The report never includes API keys or tokens: it only says whether one is stored. It is safe to share when asking for help.

database_integrity.error: The database has errors: {{message}}. Make a backup and consider restoring an earlier one.

database_schema.ok: The database schema is up to date.
database_schema.warning: The database schema is {{version}} and this app expects {{latest}}.

llm_ready.default: The AI provider in use is ready.

llm_not_ready.default: No AI provider is ready to answer. Set one up in AI Providers (model and, for cloud services, an API key).

llm_current_not_ready.default: The provider in use, {{label}}, is not set up properly (missing model or API key).

llm_cooling_down.default: {{label}} failed recently and is paused for about {{seconds}} s; another provider is used meanwhile if there is one.

llm_no_current.default: No AI provider is in use. Pick one in AI Providers.

llm_no_fallback.default: Only one AI provider is ready: if it fails, there is none to switch to automatically. Pin another one in AI Providers.

tts_missing_key.default: The {{label}} voice engine needs an API key and has none.

service_error.default: The “{{name}}” service is in error. Check its settings or the Activity tab.

stt_model_missing.default: The “{{size}}” transcription model is not downloaded: dictation and Calls cannot understand your voice until you download it.

embedding_missing.default: The semantic search model is not downloaded: memory only searches by exact words. It is optional.

recent_errors.default: There are {{count}} recent error(s) in the activity; see “Recent problems” below.

pre_restore_leftover.default: There is {{size}} of pre-restore data in the “pre-restore” folder. You can delete it by hand to free space once you are sure.

intro.title: Welcome to Project Ciel
intro.description: Let's set up the essentials in a few steps — you can skip any of them and adjust it later from Settings.

language.title: Choose your language
language.description: Applies to the whole app, including what Ciel understands and replies in.

appearance.title: Customize the appearance
appearance.description: Light or dark mode, roundness, density and typography — saved instantly.

aiProvider.title: Connect your AI provider
aiProvider.description: Project Ciel needs an OpenAI-compatible server (like LM Studio) to be able to reply.

sttVoice.title: Voice recognition (optional)
sttVoice.description: Download a local model if you want to talk to Ciel instead of typing.

ttsVoice.title: Voice synthesis (optional)
ttsVoice.description: Configure how Ciel sounds when replying by voice.

character.title: Create your first character
character.description: Project Ciel's characters are created by you — give it a name to get started.

finish.title: All set
finish.description: You can adjust any of these preferences later from Settings.

voice.emptyDescription: Create your first character in the Identity tab to set up its voice.
voice.subtitle: This character's voice settings
voice.previewDefaultText: Hi, I'm {{name}}. This is what I sound like with this setup.

fields.enabledHint: Automatically plays every chat response with this voice.
fields.voiceHintHttp: The HTTP server can't list voices — type the id it expects.
fields.pitchHintHttp: The HTTP server doesn't support pitch — this value is ignored.
fields.pitchHintElevenlabs: ElevenLabs doesn't support pitch — this value is ignored.
fields.volumeHintHttp: The HTTP server doesn't support volume — this value is ignored.
fields.volumeHintElevenlabs: ElevenLabs doesn't support volume — this value is ignored.
fields.voiceCustomIdHint: If your voice isn't in the list, paste its ID here (it's in the URL of its page on fish.audio).
fields.voiceSearchHint: Search its public catalogue by name and click one to pick it.

mood.label: Mood
mood.hint: How the character feels right now — changes with conversation and time, distinct from its (fixed) personality.

proactive.label: Proactive mode
proactive.hint: Let the character message you on its own once in a while, based on how long it's been, its mood, and its memories — never more than once every few hours.

avatar.emptyDescription: Create your first character in the Identity tab to set up its avatar.
avatar.subtitle: This character's reactive avatar
avatar.statesHint: Upload an image for each state — if one's missing, the character's profile picture is used instead.
avatar.obsHint: Turn this on and paste the URL into an OBS Browser Source — it reacts live with no window capture needed.

call.emptyDescription: Create your first character in the Identity tab to talk to it by voice.
call.policyDescription: Talk to the active character in real time over your microphone.

fields.responseModeWakePhraseHint: Useful for keeping the call open while gaming or streaming, without the character replying to everything you say.
fields.wakePhraseHint: Leave blank to use the character's name or nickname (set in Identity) as the phrase.
fields.vadModeHint: How strictly background noise gets filtered out when detecting your voice — stricter avoids false positives but can miss quiet speech.
fields.vadModeQuality: Low (more sensitive, picks up more noise)
fields.silenceTimeoutHint: How much silence has to pass before it's considered you're done talking.
fields.micLevelHint: Speak and check that the bar moves. That tells you the selected microphone is picking you up.
fields.micLevelError: Couldn't open the microphone to measure its level.
fields.speaker: Voice audio output
fields.speakerHint: Where the character's voice plays. It doesn't affect the system voice (the free Windows one), which always uses the default output. Changing it cuts off whatever is playing.
fields.echoGuardHint: While the character speaks, the microphone is ignored so it doesn't hear itself or interrupt itself. With headphones leave it off, so you can interrupt by speaking.

call.feedEmpty: Start the call and talk to see the transcript here.

twitch.connectionDescription: Connect the account that will speak in chat.
twitch.connecting: Waiting for authorization in the browser…
twitch.targetChannelHint: Type the channel you want it to reply in here, give it "/mod" if you'd like. If it's blank, it replies in its own account's chat. For a dedicated bot, connect a separate account for the bot.
twitch.targetChannelRestartNote: Stop listening to change the channel — the change doesn't apply live.
twitch.targetChannelPlaceholder: Your Twitch channel name (blank = the connected account's own)
twitch.policyDescription: The character never replies to messages from its own connected account. To test replies in real chat, type from another account, or use "Test a reply" below.

fields.responseModeMentionedHint: The character replies when someone types its name or nickname (set in Identity) in chat.
fields.cooldownHint: Keeps the character from replying too often in a busy chat.

twitch.emptyFeedTitle: Connect your account to see chat
twitch.emptyFeedDescription: The live chat feed will show up here once you connect your Twitch account.
twitch.testDescription: Try it out with a message, without posting it to chat.

emotes.title: 7TV/FFZ/BTTV emotes
emotes.visionHint: Uses a vision-capable AI provider to analyze the emotes and generate a description for each one, so the AI can use them.

discord.connectionDescription: Connect the bot's profile, not your personal account.
discord.botTokenHint: Create it at discord.com/developers/applications, in your application's Bot section — also enable the "Message Content Intent" there.
discord.connectError: Couldn't connect the bot — check that the token is correct
discord.policyDescription: Applies while the bot is listening to the servers it's in.

fields.responseModeMentionedHint: The character replies when someone @-mentions it or types its name or nickname (set in Identity).
fields.cooldownHint: Keeps the character from replying too often in a busy server.

discord.emptyFeedTitle: Connect the bot to see messages
discord.emptyFeedDescription: The live message feed will show up here once you connect the Discord bot.
discord.testDescription: Try it out with a message, without posting it to chat.

failover.quota_exceeded: Switched to {{to}}: {{from}} ran out of credits.
failover.rate_limited: Switched to {{to}}: {{from}} hit its usage limit.
failover.unreachable: Switched to {{to}}: {{from}} isn't responding (is it turned off?).
failover.timeout: Switched to {{to}}: {{from}} took too long to respond.
failover.server_error: Switched to {{to}}: {{from}} had a server error.
failover.restored: {{to}} is responding again: using it once more.
